profileEvidence.summary: Friendly and fun-loving, the Yorkie Russell is a Yorkshire Terrier–Jack Russell Terrier cross that can be affectionate and responsive to learning. Some enjoy fetch, walks and riding along in the car, with a close attachment to familiar people. Coat length and ear carriage vary, and individual dogs can differ in both size and character.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Yorkie Russells can be friendly, fun-loving companions who enjoy fetch, walks and car rides, with an interest in learning.
